China-Bangladesh Talks on Teesta Project Amid Regional Concerns

China and Bangladesh are reportedly in discussions regarding the Teesta river project. This development comes as China expresses support for Bangladesh's bids to join BRICS and the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO). China has stated that the Teesta project is not intended to target India, amidst broader regional geopolitical discussions.
